name: Prisma Gorgon
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

conditions: The kiosk is open even when Baro isn't there, so bank Ducats ahead of his visit; his window is only 48 hours.
Bronze parts are worth 15 ducats, silver 45, gold 100 (25/65 for parts demoted from vaulted relics); 600 is about six gold parts.
bonuses: Capture and Rescue fissures run under a minute; Defense fissures crack a relic every wave without re-matchmaking and drop more relics.
Selling duplicate Prime parts from other farms usually covers 600 without a dedicated run.

disclosures.title: where not to get ducats
disclosures.body: Varzia's 5 Ducats per Aya would cost 120 Aya here; that Aya is worth far more on Prime Resurgence relics. Matchmade Void Cascade and Excavation often get botched by pubs.

rows.label: Prisma Gorgon
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Prisma Gorgon comes around roughly two to four times a year.
You need his relay's planet unlocked on your Star Chart; any Ducat Kiosk shows which relay and a countdown.
MR 11 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.

disclosures.title: Incarnon Genesis
disclosures.body: The Gorgon Incarnon Genesis fits the Prisma Gorgon. It comes from the Steel Path Circuit and is installed through Cavalero, who also sells it once for 120 Steel Essence. Opinion on the Incarnon form is split over its 0.8 s explosion delay.
